name: Insights Analytics Berhad
overview: 2026年，Insights Analytics Berhad 与 Pipeline Inspection and Assessment Pty Ltd 签订马来西亚独家全国分销谅解备忘录，拟引入管道检测与漏水管理解决方案；同时与 Beijing 51 WORLD Digital Twin Technology 签订战略合作谅解备忘录，采用其 AI 驱动数字孪生方案。与 Origin Tech Limited 关于地球观测技术的谅解备忘录于 2026 年 7 月 3 日到期，公司未续期或续签。其余多项谅解备忘录（SAIC、51VR、UNIMAS 等）年内无重大进展。
overview_en: In 2026, Insights Analytics Berhad entered into an exclusive national distributorship MOU with Pipeline Inspection and Assessment Pty Ltd to bring in pipeline inspection and water loss management solutions, and a strategic collaboration MOU with Beijing 51 WORLD Digital Twin Technology Co., Ltd. to adopt its AI-driven digital twin solutions. The MOU with Origin Tech Limited on earth observation technologies expired on 3 July 2026 and the company did not extend or renew it.

segments.name: IoT 设备与仪器
segments.note: 年内签订独家全国分销谅解备忘录，拟在马来西亚分销管道检测与漏水管理产品及技术。
segments.note_en: During the year, entered into an exclusive national distributorship MOU to distribute pipeline inspection and water loss management products and technologies in Malaysia.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Pipeline Inspection and Assessment Pty Ltd 签订独家全国分销谅解备忘录，获得在马来西亚全行业代表、营销、分销、部署及商业化其产品、技术和解决方案的独家权利。
actions.text_en: Entered into an MOU for exclusive national distributorship with Pipeline Inspection and Assessment Pty Ltd, granting IAB the exclusive right to represent, market, distribute, deploy and commercialise PIA's products, technologies and solutions throughout Malays…

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 年内与 51WORLD 签订数字孪生战略合作谅解备忘录；与 Origin Tech Limited 的谅解备忘录到期未续；其他多项谅解备忘录无重大进展。
segments.note_en: During the year, signed a digital twin strategic collaboration MOU with 51WORLD; the Origin Tech Limited MOU expired without renewal; several other MOUs saw no material development.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Origin Tech Limited 关于地球观测技术部署、评估及潜在商业整合的谅解备忘录于 2026 年 7 月 3 日到期，公司未寻求延期或续签，亦未就相关事项签订最终协议。
actions.text_en: The MOU with Origin Tech Limited to explore the deployment, evaluation and potential commercial integration of earth observation enabled technologies expired on 3 July 2026;

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Sarawak Artificial Intelligence Centre Sdn. Bhd. 关于人工智能及数字孪生解决方案的谅解备忘录年内无重大进展。
actions.text_en: No material development during the year on the MOU with Sarawak Artificial Intelligence Centre Sdn. Bhd. in relation to AI and digital twin solutions.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 51VR Pty Ltd 关于在马来西亚探索及开发数字孪生解决方案市场机会的谅解备忘录年内无重大进展。
actions.text_en: No material development during the year on the MOU with 51VR Pty Ltd to explore and develop market opportunities in Malaysia for digital twin solutions.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Universiti Malaysia Sarawak 关于 AI、IoT、GIS 及数字技术研发与教育合作的谅解备忘录年内无重大进展。
actions.text_en: No material development during the year on the MOU with Universiti Malaysia Sarawak to enhance R&D, education and capabilities in AI, IoT, GIS and digital technology.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Beijing 51 WORLD Digital Twin Technology Co., Ltd. 签订战略合作谅解备忘录，采用其工业级 AI 驱动数字孪生解决方案在多个行业开发及部署应用。
actions.text_en: Entered into a strategic collaboration MOU with Beijing 51 WORLD Digital Twin Technology Co., Ltd. to adopt its industrial-grade, AI-driven digital twin solutions for the development and deployment of applications across multiple industries.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 通过独家全国分销谅解备忘录，拟在马来西亚引入并商业化 Pipeline Inspection and Assessment Pty Ltd 的管道检测、状况评估及漏水管理解决方案。
model_changes.text_en: Through an exclusive national distributorship MOU, intends to introduce and commercialise Pipeline Inspection and Assessment Pty Ltd's pipeline inspection, condition assessment and water loss management solutions in Malaysia.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 与 51WORLD 建立战略合作，采用其 AI 驱动数字孪生解决方案拓展多行业应用。
model_changes.text_en: Established a strategic collaboration with 51WORLD to adopt its AI-driven digital twin solutions for applications across multiple industries.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 与 Origin Tech Limited 的地球观测技术谅解备忘录到期未续，未签订最终协议。
model_changes.text_en: The earth observation technology MOU with Origin Tech Limited expired without renewal and no definitive agreement was entered into.
